title: Network Matrix: Why Each Organism Is a Model
description: Human: medicine. Mouse/rat: mammalian physiology and disease. Fruit fly: development and genetics. C. elegans: cell lineage and aging. Yeast: cell cycle and eukaryotic basics. E. coli: molecular biology's workhorse. Arabidopsis/rice/maize: plant biology and crops. Zebrafish: vertebrate development. Chicken: developmental biology. Dog: trait genetics. Pig: physiology and xenotransplantation research.
how_it_works: The matrix maps each node to its historical discoveries; transfer of findings follows the conserved ladder.
key_points: Every node earned model status by a landmark discovery.
Conservation lets fly/worm/yeast genetics inform human biology.
